title: Radio properties of the OH megamaser galaxy IIZw 096
question: To study the properties of the high-resolution structure of the OH megamaser emission in IIZw 096 and its connections with environmental conditions (dense gas, compact radio continuum, merging status), and determine whether the OHMs originate from a starburst or an AGN.

data.sensitivity: 1.91 mJy/beam (CO 3-2) and 1.92 mJy/beam (HCO+ 4-3) per 5.4 km s^-1 channel

evidence.loc: The total mass of D1 estimated from CO and HI observations
evidence.quote: The CO(3–2)/CO(1–0) line ratio is about 0.51 for this galaxy (cite: 2010MNRAS.406.1364L)

what.value: Optical redshift / systemic velocity of 10770 km s^-1

evidence.loc: The merging and inflow of gas to the central region
evidence.quote: The optical redshift of this source shows a system velocity of about 10770 km s$^{-1}$(cite: 2019MNRAS.489.1099D; 1995ApJS...98..129K)

what.value: Mass estimate of D1 from H-band optical image (1-4 x 10^9 M_sun)

evidence.loc: The total mass of D1 estimated from CO and HI observations
evidence.quote: Based on H-band optical image and solar metallicity, (cite: 2010AJ....140...63I) estimated that the mass of D1 is approximately 1–4 $\times$ $\rm 10^{9}$$\rm M_{\odot}$.

what.value: Lower limit for enclosed mass of D1 from MERLIN OH observations (~3 x 10^9 M_sun)

evidence.loc: The total mass of D1 estimated from CO and HI observations
evidence.quote: Based on the OH line velocities and emission region from MERLIN observations, (cite: 2011MNRAS.416.1267M) obtained a lower limit for the enclosed mass of about 3 $\rm \times10^{9}M_{\odot}$.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image EVN OH spectral-line data and combine two epochs
recipe.method: Calibrate VLBI data in AIPS, perform phase-only self-calibration on the 2005Jun08 peak channel (V ~ 10886 km s^-1), image channels in DIFMAP, average 3-sigma signals over elliptical regions for OH1 and OH2, and combine the two EVN epochs with AIPS DBCON to detect OH 1665 MHz.
key_parameters: OH 1667 MHz averaged over 10750 to 10950 km s^-1; OH 1665 MHz averaged over 11080 to 11320 km s^-1
assumptions: VLBI calibration error is ~10% of the measured flux

recipe.goal: Extract and fit ALMA CO (3-2) and HCO+ (4-3) spectra and map velocity structures
recipe.method: Extract CO (3-2) and HCO+ (4-3) spectra from archival primary-beam corrected ALMA image cubes at selected optical spots, six regions around D1, and double-peak regions, fit Gaussian profiles, and construct velocity maps.
key_parameters: Central region around D1 size ~ 400 mas

recipe.goal: Extract and fit VLA HI emission and absorption spectra
recipe.method: Image VLA-C HI data in DIFMAP, extract integrated HI spectra over a 70" x 70" region and individual spots, and fit Gaussian components.
key_parameters: 70" x 70" region for total HI spectrum

recipe.goal: Derive H2 and HI gas masses, gas surface density, and volume density
recipe.method: Calculate H2 mass from integrated CO(3-2) line flux converted to CO(1-0), calculate HI mass from integrated HI flux assuming optically thin emission, and compute gas surface density and H2 number density in the central beam.
key_parameters: Beam size 0.2" x 0.16" (~134 pc x 107 pc, ~130 pc diameter) for CO; 19.7" x 17.9" (~13.2 kpc x 12.0 kpc) for HI
assumptions: CO(3-2)/CO(1-0) line ratio = 0.51; X_CO = 0.4 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1; distance d_Mpc = 148 Mpc; optically thin HI emission

recipe.goal: Measure multi-band radio continuum fluxes, fit radio SEDs, estimate brightness temperature, and construct spectral index maps
recipe.method: Restore multi-band VLA images to 2" x 2" beam, measure total and peak flux densities of comp D and A with CASA imfit, fit radio SEDs with single power-law and mixed thermal+non-thermal models, model-fit 33 GHz VLA-A visibility data and VLBA upper limits to derive brightness temperature T_b, and construct spectral index (alpha) maps at 2" and 1" resolution.
key_parameters: Restored beam 2" x 2" for SED flux measurements and 1.4/3/9 GHz alpha-map; 1" beam for 3/9 GHz alpha-map; spectral index threshold alpha = 1.1
assumptions: For 33 GHz T_b calculation, assumed the flux density of the fitted component can also be obtained at 1.4 GHz with the same component size

score_reason: All data are public archival products and the ALMA analysis directly uses online primary-beam corrected archive cubes with standard Gaussian fitting and analytic mass formulas, with target coordinates tabulated for most spots (except DP1-DP6).
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA portion uses standard archival PB-corrected FITS cubes for project 2012.1.01022.S, gives exact J2000 coordinates for D1, A0, B0, C0, and Reg. 1-6, and reports concrete Gaussian line fits and analytic H2 mass/density values that can be directly reproduced.
